summary: A 1971 Blue Jay note describes a visit to Lobstick tower in the Pasquia Hills; towermen list has Clara Norum there 1999-2002. No build date or current site found.

staffing.status: Clara Norum listed at Lobstick 1999 to 2002; Harold Barillo listed as relief there, undated

events.note: Visit to Lobstick Fire Tower described in a note in The Blue Jay (Saskatchewan Natural History Society). The visit date is not given; the note is dated from the page's 1971 society notice.

notes_for_editor: Record coordinates (53.6615, -102.01078) match the websiteservice list (53-39-41.4 N, 102-00-38.8 W); no correction. The 1971 Blue Jay note is the only first-hand account found, and the visit date within 1971 is not given. Name clash: search snippets describe a 2026 wildfire called Lobstick in the Nisbet Forest near Duck Lake; those are not read and are not this tower. Record agency is unconfirmed, the same issue as Kingsmere (see that file). The towermen list note on Richard Sevigny (all towers condemned after mid-August 2001, six to be rebuilt) names no towers and is not applied here. Not checked: Saskatchewan Archives annual reports for Lobstick or the Pasquia Hills.
